name: filters
summary: The product's filtering components, grouped by ARCHETYPE (not by the screen they sit in). Four distinct kinds: the Expression builder (nested AND/OR query builder), the Filter bar (inline chips), Quick filters (preset menu), and the Filter row (multi-selects + Reset/Apply). These are molecules; the Toolbars (organisms) compose them.

kind.description: which filter archetype to render — bar (FlotoFilterBar ~50×), expression (FiltersContainer 32×), quick (preset menu), row (multi-selects + Reset/Apply), vertical (faceted sidebar). Filters is MULTI-ARCHETYPE: per-archetype prop/event contracts live in the apis block below, not as element props.

match.note: the Match toggle mode: all (AND) | any (OR). Driven + emitted (was internal-only).

renders: REFERENCE REPRODUCTIONS — the live filters are store-bound (FilterCondition is 500+ lines). The Filter bar reproduction is fully interactive.

ExpressionBuilder.source: src/components/filters/ — FiltersContainer (filters-container.vue) + Filters (filters.vue) + FilterGroup + FilterCondition (516 ln) + FilterTrigger
ExpressionBuilder.presentation: an MPopover (placement bottomLeft, has-arrow) opened from a FilterTrigger input (renders the applied query, or a 'Search' placeholder) — NOT an inline panel. Popover has a close x, Pre Filters / Post Filters tabs (MTab), the builder, and a Reset / Clear / Apply footer. Apply emits the query (trigger shows it) and closes; Clear empties; Reset reverts.
ExpressionBuilder.what: a nested AND/OR query builder: 'Group(s) matching All/Any' -> one or more groups (3 pre / 1 post), each 'Include/Exclude -> Group matching All/Any -> Criteria' -> conditions (counter · operator · value; Between -> From/To). Add Condition (max 3) / Add New Group.
ExpressionBuilder.props: MultipleFormItems drive the group/condition lists; FilterCondition is type-aware (operator + value picker by field type)
ExpressionBuilder.storybook: fully functional reproduction (open/close, tabs, add/remove conditions+groups, Include/Exclude + All/Any, Between, Apply renders the query into the trigger)

FilterBar.what: an inline CHIP bar — field·operator·value chips (default-chips have no ×) + '+ Filter' + a Match All/Any toggle + Clear All. Chips scroll horizontally; the segment picker floats position:fixed.
FilterBar.note: moved here from the former Grid Toolbar entry

QuickFilters.what: a thumbs-up button opening a panel of PRESET one-click filters ({ key, label, condition }); picking one applies that condition
QuickFilters.note: moved here from the former Grid Toolbar entry

FilterRow.what: the simplest filter — a few multi-selects (Groups/Severity/Tags) + Reset/Apply + close ×, as a slide-in over a list
FilterRow.note: re-homed from the retired Monitoring Config (Collection Filters)

VerticalFilter.source: components/filters/vertical-filter/filters.vue (shared: APM Explorer, APM Error Tracker, RUM Sessions) + ncm/components/explorer-grid-virtical-filter.vue (richer NCM variant)
VerticalFilter.what: the FACETED left-panel sidebar — a search atop collapsible groups (MCollapse), each row a checkbox + optional status/type icon + label + count; checking rows filters the grid
VerticalFilter.note: looks like a Navigation side menu but it FILTERS (not navigates) -> lives in Filters; cross-referenced from Navigation -> Side menu. Surfaced by the 2026-06-16 left-panel sweep.

decisionFlow: Complex AND/OR conditions across multiple groups? -> Expression builder (FiltersContainer, 32×).
A compact inline chip bar over a grid? -> Filter bar.
A few simple multi-selects + Apply/Reset? -> Filter row.
Plain text search of a list? -> the Input 'search' type (181×), not a Filter.
do: Use the Expression builder for real query logic (groups + AND/OR + typed operators).
Use the Filter bar for a compact chip filter over a grid.
Use Quick filters for common one-click presets.
Use a Filter row for a small fixed set of facets.
dont: Don't hand-roll a condition builder — use FiltersContainer.
Don't put plain search here — that's the Input search type.
Don't duplicate a filter across screens — it's one molecule; compose it in a Toolbar.

F1.issue: Store-bound / FilterCondition is 500+ lines, so these render as reproductions (the Filter bar reproduction is fully interactive).

knownIssues.element: [element] obs-filters (kind=bar) is now FUNCTIONAL: pass fields (array/JSON: {key,label,type,values}) + value (active conditions); it emits a change event with the conditions and reflects el.value on every edit. The bar has NO always-on empty 'Select Filter' chip — the '+ Filter' button is the sole add affordance (it inserts a fresh chip and opens the field picker; an abandoned/unpicked chip is discarded on click-outside). value='[]' / Clear All → an empty bar showing only '+ Filter'. Other kinds (expression/vertical/quick/row) remain visual references.

props.fieldSchema: Array (required) — the filterable fields + their operator/value types
props.defaultChips: Array — leading non-removable chips declared by the consuming module (e.g. Groups/Types/Severity)

FilterBar.note: PITFALL: the leading default-chips come from the MODULE via defaultChips, not the base bar — read a real consumer to reproduce faithfully.

a11y.summary: Field/operator/value selects (FlotoDropdownPicker) + real buttons (+Filter, Add, Reset/Apply); convey the nested Group→Condition structure to AT.
issues: Icon-only triggers (thumbs-up, chip ×, row ×) need accessible names.
a11y.$note: Catalogue-wide gap SF-001 = no visible :focus-visible ring; tracked in findings/.

changelog: 2026-08-09 — Filter-bar fixes (consumer G16/G17/G18): (G16) the vanishing chip — the write-back now compares LIKE WITH LIKE (JSON-normalised, so an array seed no longer looks different from its string form) and NEVER rebuilds internal state from its own reflect, so a half-built chip survives and a filter can be added in ONE pass. (G18) the Match toggle is now a real driven `match` prop (all|any) and the mode is EMITTED — the `change` payload is now {conditions, match} (was a bare conditions array — update your handler). (G17) Match only shows at >=2 conditions (meaningless at one). Verified end-to-end.

expression-builder.useWhen: You need real query logic — complex AND/OR conditions across one or more nested groups with typed operators. This is the most-used filter (FiltersContainer, 32×): a FilterTrigger input opens an MPopover with Pre/Post Filters tabs, 'Group(s) matching All/Any' → groups (Include/Exclude, matching All/Any) → conditions (field · operator · value, type-aware, Between → From/To), Add Condition (max 3) / Add New Group, and a Reset / Clear / Apply footer where Apply emits the query and renders it back into the trigger.
expression-builder.dontUse: Don't use for a compact chip filter over a grid (→ Filter bar) or a small fixed set of facets (→ Filter row). Don't hand-roll a condition builder — always compose FiltersContainer. For plain text search of a list, use the Input 'search' type, not this.
expression-builder.example: The nested AND/OR query builder popover opened from a search-style FilterTrigger over a grid — the 32× FiltersContainer usage, with Pre/Post Filter tabs and Include/Exclude groups matching All/Any.

filter-bar.useWhen: You want a compact inline chip filter sitting directly over a grid. The Filter bar (FlotoFilterBar, ~50×) renders field·operator·value chips (default-chips declared by the module via defaultChips have no ×), a '+ Filter' button, a Match All/Any toggle, and Clear All; chips scroll horizontally while the segment picker floats position:fixed so it never clips.
filter-bar.dontUse: Don't use when you need nested groups or AND/OR logic beyond a flat Match All/Any (→ Expression builder). Don't use for one-click presets (→ Quick filters) or a slide-in facet panel (→ Filter row). Not for plain text search (→ Input 'search' type).
filter-bar.example: The inline chip bar over a data grid where the module seeds leading default-chips (e.g. Groups/Types/Severity via defaultChips) and users add field·operator·value chips with Match All/Any — the ~50× FlotoFilterBar usage.

quick-filters.useWhen: You want to expose common, one-click preset filters. Quick filters (filter-quick-menu) is a thumbs-up button that opens a panel of PRESET filters as { key, label, condition }; picking one immediately applies that condition.
quick-filters.dontUse: Don't use when users must author arbitrary conditions or groups (→ Expression builder) or maintain an evolving chip set over a grid (→ Filter bar). Not for facet multi-selects with Reset/Apply (→ Filter row).
quick-filters.example: The thumbs-up preset menu beside a grid toolbar offering saved one-click filters ({ key, label, condition }) — click a preset to apply its condition instantly.

filter-row.useWhen: You have a small, fixed set of facets to filter a list — a few multi-selects (e.g. Groups / Severity / Tags) plus Reset/Apply and a close ×, presented as a slide-in over the list.
filter-row.dontUse: Don't use for real query logic with nested AND/OR groups (→ Expression builder), for an inline chip bar over a grid (→ Filter bar), or for one-click presets (→ Quick filters).
filter-row.example: The slide-in Collection Filters panel over a monitoring list — a few multi-selects (Groups/Severity/Tags) with Reset/Apply and a close × (pattern e.g. metric-collection-filters.vue).

vertical-filter.useWhen: You need a faceted left-panel sidebar that filters (not navigates) a grid. The vertical filter is a search box atop collapsible MCollapse groups, each row a checkbox + optional status/type icon + label + count; checking rows narrows the grid. Used across APM Explorer, APM Error Tracker, RUM Sessions, and a richer NCM Explorer variant.
vertical-filter.dontUse: Don't confuse it with a Navigation side menu — it filters, so it lives in Filters (cross-referenced from Navigation → Side menu). Don't use it for a compact inline chip filter (→ Filter bar) or nested AND/OR logic (→ Expression builder).
vertical-filter.example: The APM Explorer / RUM Sessions left-panel faceted sidebar — a search over collapsible checkbox+count groups (with status/type icons) that filters the results grid; NCM Explorer uses the richer variant.

bar-wiring.useWhen: kind="bar": pass fields + value (active conditions) + match (all|any); listen to `change` for {conditions, match}.
bar-wiring.dontUse: seeding value as an ARRAY via the el.value PROPERTY at mount if you are on <0.1.150 (it hit the vanishing-chip bug). Fixed now; array or string both work.
bar-wiring.must: read the `change` payload as {conditions, match} — it is NO LONGER a bare conditions array. `el.value` still reflects the conditions JSON.
bar-wiring.example: <obs-filters kind="bar" fields=... value=... match="all" @change="e => { const {conditions, match} = e.detail[0] }">
